canonical_example.text: El comité aceptó su tesis.

canonical_example.translation: We take all credit cards, but no personal checks.

canonical_example.translation: I have to go sign the lease agreement for my new apartment this afternoon.

canonical_example.text: Le trajo flores para expresarle el cariño que sentía por ella.
canonical_example.translation: He brought her flowers to show her the affection he felt for her.
